scope: Independent offline audit of the closed physical-input smoke; no native/JVM/script import/input/process mutation.

coverage.session_id_limit: nREPL per-eval session IDs are not TCP connection IDs; one connect is supported by fixed source and one worker journal, not packet capture.

process_evidence.os_absence_check: Root reported four principal PIDs absent; this audit independently verifies saved Popen/reap records, not fresh /proc absence.

limits: One young ordinary nebula only; no natural planets or handoff members during any snapshot.
No aiming helper execution, pursuit, interception, binding, commitment, intervention or Gate proof.
No injected partial-write, cap, timeout, cancellation or other failure-path runtime qualification.
Raw journals encode decoded response maps, not original bencode network packets.
Nil published thrust does not erase prior Jacobi influence or physical momentum.
Published recentered position/velocity changes include natural dynamics and frame motion; not isolated thrust displacement.
No native FPS or isolated performance improvement claim; durations overlap ordinary rendering.
Actual key release elapsed2.029s is observed, not a hard OS scheduling guarantee.

edn_data_only_command: (require '[clojure.edn :as edn] '[clojure.string :as str] '[cheshire.core :as json]) (let [d (first *command-line-args*) read-lines (fn [p] (mapv edn/read-string (str/split-lines (slurp (str d p))))) messages (read-lines "/snapshot-messages.edn")] (println (json/generate-string {:journal (read-lines "/snapshot-requests.edn") :messages messages :values (mapv (fn [m] {:id (:id m) :snapshot (edn/read-string (:value m))}) (filter #(contains? % :value) messages))})))

import ast, collections, datetime, hashlib, json, math, statistics, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); bundle=root/'.ημ/diagnostics/physical-approach'; run=bundle/'runs/attempt-01'; control=bundle/'completion-client-runs/attempt-01'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
closed=read(run/'closed.json'); result=read(control/'result.json')
assert closed['stage']=='closed' and closed['outcome']=='operator-stop'
assert not closed['cleanup_errors'] and not closed['unreaped_children'] and not closed['budget_exceeded']
assert closed['key_pending'] is None and not closed['key_release_uncertain'] and not closed['mouse_pending'] and not closed['mouse_release_uncertain']
assert result['outcome']=='passed' and not result['errors'] and not result['unreaped_client_pids'] and not result['controller_budget_exceeded'] and result['closed']==closed
operations=[json.loads(x) for x in (run/'operations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
controller=[json.loads(x) for x in (control/'controller.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
events=lambda kind:[x for x in operations if x['kind']==kind]
cevents=lambda kind:[x for x in controller if x['kind']==kind]
edn_code="""(require '[clojure.edn :as edn] '[clojure.string :as str] '[cheshire.core :as json]) (let [d (first *command-line-args*) read-lines (fn [p] (mapv edn/read-string (str/split-lines (slurp (str d p))))) messages (read-lines \"/snapshot-messages.edn\")] (println (json/generate-string {:journal (read-lines \"/snapshot-requests.edn\") :messages messages :values (mapv (fn [m] {:id (:id m) :snapshot (edn/read-string (:value m))}) (filter #(contains? % :value) messages))})))"""
argv=['bb','-e',edn_code,str(run)]
parsed=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
assert parsed.returncode==0,parsed.stderr
assert not parsed.stderr
edn=json.loads(parsed.stdout); journal=edn['journal']; messages=edn['messages']; values={x['id']:x['snapshot'] for x in edn['values']}
raw=(run/'snapshot-messages.edn').read_bytes(); lines=raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
assert len(lines)==len(messages) and all(x.endswith(b'\n') for x in lines)
starts=[x for x in journal if x['event']=='request-start']; finishes=[x for x in journal if x['event']=='request-finish']
assert len(starts)==len(finishes)==50 and len(journal)==102
assert journal[0]['event']=='connection-open' and journal[-1]['event']=='connection-close'
assert journal[0]['pid']==closed['snapshot_client']['pid'] and journal[-1]['completed']==50 and journal[-1]['byte-end']==len(raw)
assert [x['event'] for x in journal[1:-1]]==['request-start','request-finish']*50
ids=[f'{n:04d}' for n in range(1,51)]
assert [x['id'] for x in starts]==[x['id'] for x in finishes]==ids
assert len(values)==50
spans=[]; position=0; row=0; all_stdout={}; sessions=set()
expected={k:closed['app'][k] for k in ('pid','boot','start','cwd')};expected.update(display=closed['display'],port=str(closed['port']),world=closed['world'],window=closed['window'])
for start,finish in zip(starts,finishes):
    ident=start['id']; count=finish['messages']; chunk=messages[row:row+count]; encoded=b''.join(lines[row:row+count]); row+=count
    assert start['byte-start']==finish['byte-start']==position
    assert finish['byte-end']==position+len(encoded) and finish['raw-bytes']==len(encoded)
    assert raw[position:finish['byte-end']]==encoded and len(encoded)<=4*1024*1024
    assert all(m['id']==ident for m in chunk)
    assert not any(m.get('err') or m.get('ex') or m.get('root-ex') for m in chunk)
    assert all(set(m.get('status',[]))<= {'done'} for m in chunk)
    assert sum('done' in m.get('status',[]) for m in chunk)==1 and chunk[-1].get('status')==['done']
    assert sum('value' in m for m in chunk)==1 and finish['outcome']=='ok' and finish['expected']==expected
    assert start['expected']==(expected if ident!='0001' else {k:v for k,v in expected.items() if k not in ('world','window')})
    text=''.join(m.get('out','')+(m['value']+'\n' if 'value' in m else '') for m in chunk);all_stdout[ident]=text
    assert text.count('TRUTH_APPROACH_ID '+str(closed['world'])+' '+str(closed['window'])+'\n')==1
    snap=values[ident];assert snap['identity']['world-atom']==closed['world'] and snap['identity']['window']==closed['window'] and snap['identity']['pid']==closed['app']['pid']
    assert snap['world']['demo/scenario']=='nebula' and snap['world']['demo/fixture?'] is False
    sessions.update(m['session'] for m in chunk if 'session' in m)
    spans.append({'id':ident,'byte_start':position,'byte_end':finish['byte-end'],'bytes':len(encoded),'messages':count,'elapsed_ms':finish['elapsed-ms'],'tick':snap['world']['tick'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()})
    position=finish['byte-end']
assert position==len(raw) and row==len(messages) and len(raw)<=128*1024*1024
assert (run/'snapshot-current.result').read_text()=='0050 ok\n'
assert (run/'snapshot-current.stdout').read_text()==all_stdout['0050']
transcript=[x for x in operations if x['kind'] in ('snapshot-request','snapshot-result','snapshot-consumed')]
assert len(transcript)==150
for i,ident in enumerate(ids):
    request,ack,consume=transcript[i*3:i*3+3]
    assert [x['kind'] for x in (request,ack,consume)]==['snapshot-request','snapshot-result','snapshot-consumed']
    assert request['id']==ack['id']==consume['id']==ident and ack['verdict']==ident+' ok'
    assert consume['stdout_utf8_bytes']==len(all_stdout[ident].encode('utf-8'))
assert not any(x['kind'] in ('failure','timeout','snapshot-timeout','snapshot-client-close-timeout') for x in operations)
sequence=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in ast.parse((bundle/'short-smoke-client.py').read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='SEQUENCE' for t in n.targets))
assert result['completed']==result['planned_sequence']==[list(x) for x in sequence]
requests=[x['request'] for x in events('request')];assert len(requests)==16
assert [[x['operation'],*x['args']] for x in requests]==[list(x) for x in sequence]
for request in requests:
    ident=request['id'];assert read(run/'requests'/f'{ident}.json')==request
    assert read(run/'results'/f'{ident}.json')['ok'] is True
assert len(list((run/'requests').glob('*.json')))==len(list((run/'results').glob('*.json')))==16
commands=events('command');spawns=events('spawn');reaps=events('reaped')
assert len(commands)==len(spawns)==len(reaps)==35
assert len({x['identity']['pid'] for x in spawns})==35
assert {(x['identity']['pid'],x['label']) for x in spawns}=={(x['pid'],x['label']) for x in reaps}
assert all(x['returncode'] is not None for x in reaps)
assert collections.Counter(x['returncode'] for x in reaps)=={0:34,143:1}
assert next(x for x in reaps if x['returncode']==143)['pid']==closed['app']['pid']
assert len([x for x in commands if 'snapshot_client.clj' in ' '.join(x['command'])])==1
assert len(cevents('client-spawn'))==len(cevents('client-exit'))==18
assert {x['pid'] for x in cevents('client-spawn')}=={x['pid'] for x in cevents('client-exit')}
assert all(x['returncode']==0 and x['reaped'] for x in cevents('client-exit'))
xd=[x['command'][1:] for x in commands if x['command'][0]=='xdotool']
assert xd.count(['keydown','w'])==xd.count(['keyup','w'])==1
assert xd.count(['mousedown','1'])==xd.count(['mouseup','1'])==5
assert not any('click' in x for x in xd)
knobs=events('thrust-knob-expectation');assert [(x['action'],x['before'],x['expected']) for x in knobs]==[('thrust-up',1e7,2e7),('thrust-down',2e7,1e7)]
observations=events('input-observation');matched=[x for x in observations if x['matched']]
assert any(x['label']=='range-fine' and x['state']['displacement']==1e7 for x in matched)
assert any(x['label']=='range-thrust-up' and x['state']['displacement']==2e7 for x in matched)
assert any(x['label']=='range-thrust-down' and x['state']['displacement']==1e7 for x in matched)
looks=events('look-expectation');assert [x['requested_pixels'] for x in looks]==[[100,0],[-100,0],[0,100],[0,-100]]
assert len([x for x in matched if x['label']=='look'])==4
start=events('hold-start')[0];hold=events('hold-complete')[0];release=events('hold-release')[0]
assert start['requested_seconds']==2 and start['key']=='w' and release['release_elapsed_seconds']<=10 and not release['exceeds_ten_seconds']
yaw,pitch=map(math.radians,[start['controls']['yaw'],start['controls']['pitch']]);expected_direction=[-math.cos(pitch)*math.cos(yaw),-math.cos(pitch)*math.sin(yaw),-math.sin(pitch)];norm=math.hypot(*expected_direction);expected_direction=[v/norm for v in expected_direction]
assert all(abs(a-b)<=1e-9 for a,b in zip(expected_direction,start['expected_thrust']))
assert hold['before']['thrust'] is None and hold['after']['thrust'] is None and hold['before']['tick']<hold['during']['tick']<hold['after']['tick']
assert all(abs(a-b)<=1e-9 for a,b in zip(expected_direction,hold['during']['thrust']))
for name in ('before','during','after'):
    state=hold[name];snapshots=[v for v in values.values() if v['world']['tick']==state['tick']]
    assert any(v['spark']['position']==state['position'] and v['spark']['velocity']==state['velocity'] and v['spark']['thrust']==state['thrust'] for v in snapshots)
assert hold['observed_tick_delta']==hold['after']['tick']-hold['before']['tick']==20
assert hold['position_delta']==[a-b for a,b in zip(hold['after']['position'],hold['before']['position'])]
assert hold['velocity_delta']==[a-b for a,b in zip(hold['after']['velocity'],hold['before']['velocity'])]
assert events('hold-release-observation')[0]['state']['thrust'] is not None and events('hold-release-observation')[-1]['state']['thrust'] is None
sources=read(run/'source-hashes.json');pins=read(run/'preparation-hashes.json')
assert len(sources)==186 and all(sha(root/name)==digest for name,digest in sources.items())
assert pins==read(bundle/'preparation-hashes.json') and all(sha(bundle/name)==digest for name,digest in pins.items())
manifest=[]
for line in (bundle/'SHA256SUMS').read_text().splitlines():
    digest,name=line.split('  ',1);assert sha(bundle/name)==digest;manifest.append(name)
assert len(manifest)==10
assert result['runner_sha256']==sha(bundle/'runner.py') and result['controller_sha256']==sha(bundle/'short-smoke-client.py')
worker_stem=next(x['label'] for x in spawns if x['identity']['pid']==closed['snapshot_client']['pid'])
assert (run/(worker_stem+'.stdout')).stat().st_size==(run/(worker_stem+'.stderr')).stat().st_size==0
proof=read(bundle/'COPY-PROOF.json');assert sources==proof['production_source_hashes']
assert all(not v['bodies'] and not v['production-handoff-write-set'] and v['body-coverage']['total']==0 for v in values.values())
inputfiles=sorted(list(run.rglob('*'))+list(control.rglob('*')))
inputhashes={str(p.relative_to(bundle)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p)} for p in inputfiles if p.is_file()}
latencies=[x['elapsed-ms'] for x in finishes]
